title: Calm the Ripples
instructions: Players must hum a short melody together for 10 seconds without stopping.

title: Bottle Message
instructions: Write a two-line encouraging message to another player within 30 seconds.

title: Tide Memory
instructions: One player lists 5 items seen near the shore; the next repeats and adds one more. Continue until someone forgets.

title: Wave Pattern
instructions: Using only hand motions, players must create a repeating two-step wave pattern together for 6 beats.

title: Storm Navigation
instructions: Blindfold one player and guide them verbally across a small obstacle course in under 30 seconds.

title: Echo of the Deep
instructions: Players must collectively tell a short improvised story about the sea, each adding one sentence, keeping it coherent for 8 sentences.

npc.name: Aino
npc.title: Spirit of the Living Waters
npc.description: A calm, guiding spirit who asks the players to restore balance to the shore.
dialogue: Greetings, travelers. The waters whisper — will you help?
Bring back the sunken rune and quiet the restless tides.
Return when the Sampo sings and I shall bless your journey.

quest.title: The Sunken Rune
quest.description: Locate the hidden rune beneath the waves by completing the following mini-games.
